text:
Ava (Marketing): Draft ready for review: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/serve-launch-v2 — mostly copy changes and CTA.
Sam (Content): reading. Lede needs a tighter hook. recommend 1 short sentence + metric.
Diego (Product): Agree. Can we include single-line benchmark: e.g. 'up to 3.2x lower per-token latency in our internal test harness'? will add link to raw run.
Ava (Marketing): Good — please paste the run link so legal can review citation.
Diego (Product): link: https://bench.redwood.ai/runs/2026-05-07-serve-v2 — raw configs & numbers in the run notes.
Priya (Legal): Quick flag: avoid definitive comparative superlatives like 'fastest' without explicit comparator. Use 'up to' or 'vs earlier generation'. Also need the test harness link visible in the footnote.
Sam (Content): changed lead to "Predictable inference, lower unit cost." tightened transitions to demo + signup.
Marisol (Design): Uploaded hero options in Figma (file: serve-hero-options). Suggest alt text: 'Graph comparing latency and throughput on Redwood Dedicated'. Need final CTA microcopy.
Noah (Growth): CTA proposal: "Download benchmark + reserve webinar spot" — this needs to trigger gated PDF and webinar reg flow. I'll wire HubSpot.
Ava (Marketing): CTA phrasing looks good. Noah, please confirm the HubSpot form id when ready.
Noah (Growth): will post form id in this thread once created.
Tyler (Infra): I can present the kv-cache + batching section on the webinar. May 12 works for me.
Ava (Marketing): Great — speakers: Ava, Diego, Tyler. Sam, update speaker blurbs.
Sam (Content): Done. Short bios added and a line about demo timeline.
Priya (Legal): Reviewed the new phrasing and footnote link to the run. One comment on the data retention sentence (small wording tweak) left in doc. Otherwise legal OK.
Ava (Marketing): Noted. I'll apply retention wording change now.
PublishBot: preview build: https://preview.redwood.ai/blog/serve-launch-v2 status: SUCCESS
Ava (Marketing): Final approvals: Priya (legal) ✅, Marisol (design) ✅, Sam (content) ✅. Diego?
Diego (Product): Approve benchmark phrasing: "up to 3.2x lower per-token latency in our internal benchmark (see footnote)" — approved.
Noah (Growth): HubSpot form created: form_6482. Mapping: registrants -> webinar list, gated-pdf -> download flow. I'll confirm tracking params.
Marisol (Design): Final CTA button text: "See benchmarks & join webinar". Assets uploaded to /assets/serve-launch.
Ava (Marketing): Plan: push final draft at 10:15 PT, schedule publish 13:00 PT. If no blockers by 12:30 PT we go live.
Priya (Legal): Resolved my doc comment. Legal green.
Sam (Content): Tiny punctuation nit fixed.
Ava (Marketing): All set, thanks team. Publishing shortly. :rocket:
file_notes: short internal marketing slack thread for a product launch blog post: approvals, CTA/gating, webinar speaker confirm, legal citation link, preview bot
